title: Punctuality and predictions
description: Mobilis buses: arrivals against the schedule, TripUpdates predictions against arrivals, and scheduled trips seen in the realtime feeds. The time range selects service dates.

list.name: route
list.label: Route
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT route_short_name FROM marts.route_punctuality WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Arrivals on time
panels.description: From 1 minute early to 3 minutes late, judged by the middle of the arrival window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(on_time_arrivals)::numeric / nullif(sum(arrivals), 0) AS on_time
FROM marts.route_punctuality
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})

panels.title: Arrivals
panels.description: First arrivals at each stop of a trip, within 50 m of the stop and with a window of at most 60 s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(arrivals) AS arrivals
FROM marts.route_punctuality
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})

panels.title: Predictions within 1 minute, made 5 minutes before

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(accurate_predictions)::numeric / nullif(sum(predicted_arrivals), 0) AS accurate
FROM marts.prediction_accuracy
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})
    AND horizon_minutes = 5

panels.title: Trips seen in vehicle positions
panels.description: Scheduled trips that ran while VehiclePositions was collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(seen_trips)::numeric / nullif(sum(collected_trips), 0) AS seen
FROM marts.trip_coverage
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})

SELECT
    service_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw' AS time,
    sum(on_time_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS "on time",
    sum(late_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS late,
    sum(early_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS early
FROM marts.route_punctuality
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY service_date
ORDER BY service_date

panels.title: Arrivals on time by service hour
panels.description: Hours past 24 belong to the night trips of the previous service date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    lpad(service_hour::text, 2, '0') AS hour,
    sum(on_time_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS "on time"
FROM marts.route_punctuality
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY service_hour
ORDER BY service_hour

panels.title: Within 1 minute of the arrival, by horizon
panels.description: The prediction in force that many minutes before the arrival, against the scheduled time, on the same arrivals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    horizon_minutes || ' min' AS horizon,
    sum(accurate_predictions)::numeric / nullif(sum(predicted_arrivals), 0) AS prediction,
    sum(accurate_schedule_times)::numeric / nullif(sum(predicted_arrivals), 0) AS schedule
FROM marts.prediction_accuracy
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY horizon_minutes
ORDER BY horizon_minutes

panels.title: Scheduled trips seen in the realtime feeds
panels.description: Share of the trips that ran while VehiclePositions was collected. TripUpdates is left out for hours older than the predictions kept.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    service_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw' AS time,
    sum(seen_trips)::numeric / nullif(sum(collected_trips), 0) AS "vehicle positions",
    sum(predicted_trips)::numeric
        / nullif(sum(collected_trips) FILTER (WHERE predicted_trips IS NOT NULL), 0)
        AS "trip updates"
FROM marts.trip_coverage
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY service_date
ORDER BY service_date

SELECT
    route_short_name AS route,
    sum(arrivals) AS arrivals,
    sum(on_time_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS "on time",
    sum(late_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS late,
    sum(early_arrivals)::numeric / sum(arrivals) AS early
FROM marts.route_punctuality
WHERE $__timeFilter(service_date)
    AND route_short_name IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY route_short_name
ORDER BY arrivals DESC
